results.title: Thirty windows, one button - Product Hunt
results.content:
SurveyMonkey — Your best decisions start with listening

SurveyMonkey now asks your customers questions in conversation, the way a person actually would, and hands the answers back already analysed. Nobody fills in a grid of radio buttons voluntarily. It benchmarks your numbers against companies in your space, so you find out whether your score is good or quietly terrible, and it plugs into ChatGPT and Slack so the feedback lands where you already argue about things, with no research team to hire and no fieldwork to wait on.

Captain Kill Switch — Close all your open apps in one click [...] Captain Kill Switch is one button in your menu bar that closes every running app. Simon Crean built it after the same stupid moment kept repeating, finishing for the day with thirty-odd windows open and shutting them one at a time, which he describes as tidying a room by picking up individual grains of rice. No dashboard, no settings, no account. Anything still open a couple of seconds later gets force-closed, unsaved work and all, and he says that on the launch page rather than letting you find out on a Friday evening, which is the right way round.

results.title: Omni: The all-in-one tool to supercharge your productivity | Product Hunt
results.content:
Hey Product Hunt 👋 Over the holidays I've been thinking about all the time I lose doing menial tasks: finding the right tab in Chrome (I have far too many :P), starting meetings, creating tasks, clearing cookies and cache to help debug problems in websites, looking through my browser history to find a site I forgot about, etc. So I decided to build Omni as a tool to do it all through an omnisearch interface. With just one click (or key press) you can perform any action or browse through all sorts of data in Chrome. No need for your mouse anymore. Here are some of its features: 🗄 Switch, open, close, and search your tabs 📚 Browse and manage your bookmarks 🔍 Search your browsing history ⚡️ 50+ actions to improve your productivity 🔮 Special commands to filter and perform more actions 🧩 [...] Report
